Waqf Board Corrects Gazette Errors, Offers Relief to Malkajgiri Property Owners

The Waqf Board has announced it will correct errors in its gazette notification concerning Malkajgiri properties. This correction is expected to provide relief to approximately 10,000 property owners in the Malkajgiri area. The board's clarification addresses a survey error that had impacted these property titles. The decision aims to resolve discrepancies and offer clarity to affected individuals.
